crossRefs.note: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go…
He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in…
One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains…
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be…
how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was…
For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…

translations.web: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”
translations.bsb: That is why I told you that you would die in your sins. For unless you believe that I am He, you will die in your sins.”
translations.kjv: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
translations.asv: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for except ye believe that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
